name: Hidden Categories
author: hardlysleeping
description: Temporarily hide categories from the sidebar and main stream. One button cycles hidden / revealed / only-hidden, with a sidebar row whose label and count can each be switched off. Light filters in the browser and writes nothing; Strict hides feeds on every synced client. Pin lock is on by default (0000, 1-6 digits, stored in plain text as a curtain rather than security). Hiding works on its own; the sidebar right-click item needs Right Click Actions (xExtension-RightClickActions) installed.
